features.acceptance: All platforms share identity, atmosphere, curator guidance, taste constellation and mesh topology with existing source/access steps. A fresh node must onboard before the cinema stage; completed nodes resume, and joining a Home stays optional. Input survives Back; public/personal setup reaches deployment without credentials, and validated external-media adapters are normal optional connections, not blanket beta. Personal/public-domain remains default; no experimental toggle substitutes for provider validation.

Profiles retain isolated taste, color, collections, and history. Shared local ranking replaces duplicate heuristic scoring only after comparison tests. Learn informative next taste questions and distinguish interruption/background viewing from dislike; explicit reactions take precedence and Dismiss remains neutral.

Search sits below hero; No idea returns only source-available choices. Personalized artwork selection may learn from local preferences without moving navigation, inferring sensitive traits or overriding chosen appearance.
Featured invitation, illustrated paths, shelves, and Refine stay distinct and uncluttered.

Titles, people, moods, exclusions, duration, books, and remembered scenes explain ambiguity honestly. Locally indexed dialogue and scene evidence support semantic retrieval beyond synonym tables; hard exclusions remain enforced and visual-scene claims require actual visual evidence.

Action state derives from actual media/source readiness and exposes recovery. Prefer compatible originals/existing renditions and remux/audio-only paths; use verified prepared renditions before live video encoding. Never label partial or unvalidated output ready; preparation failures expose retry and an honest fallback. Device/source selection uses measured compatibility and predicted startup/buffering cost, never platform-name assumptions alone. Background viewing may prefer an economical prepared copy; normal viewing selects suitable quality without unnecessary larger downloads.

An authorized household manager can use a phone or another ReelOS node to set a named computer/device storage budget and background-preparation preferences; the target acknowledges applied state, while offline changes remain pending. Pairing alone grants no cross-device management authority to children or guests. Provider disable removes inaccessible projections without deleting personal files; derived renditions cannot bypass source access. The household storage slider budgets automatic ready-to-play copies with visible usage, protected free space, and temporary-output reservations. Budget reduction evicts only disposable managed copies, never originals, pinned media, or in-use files. Preparation status, cancel, failure, and retry are reachable.
Reading location, bookmarks, and appearance persist per profile; Books is absent in TV mode.

Child policy is enforced server-side, not merely represented by a screen. Model-derived annotations cannot silently lower parent restrictions. Verify edition/timestamp alignment and conservative handling of missing/conflicting annotations; catalog eligibility is separate from actually muting audio, editing subtitles or skipping scenes.
Presence affects this session without changing profile identity or exposing history.

Story material never claims playback-position knowledge without a verified service. Cached analysis carries timestamped evidence and exact-edition alignment; summaries and contextual answers are bounded by the viewer's progress and must not leak later events through whole-film context. Scene understanding includes timestamped dialogue, local audio analysis and sampled visual evidence, not just cast lists or whole-film plot text. Test character/context questions and missed-moment retrieval with spoiler-bounded inputs, uncertain/absent evidence, edition mismatch, memory and latency budgets.

Household matching and remote parties keep distinct host/join flows. Household matching balances participating profiles' enthusiasm and objections locally without revealing private histories; evaluate against simple average ranking.

Use one shared Kotlin engine and Compose UI for Windows, Linux, Android phone/tablet and TV with native platform adapters. Require physical Windows workstation, Onn TV, Galaxy Fold and HP Ubuntu appliance acceptance as specified in owner-requirements.md. Adding a device does not restart onboarding; progress is service-backed. Windows, Linux, Android phone/tablet and Android TV are full standalone ReelOS nodes built from the one canonical codebase, using device-native consumer interfaces over shared state, neural, design-token and behavior contracts. Those targets must not ship an external browser, localhost web UI, embedded WebView, Electron or other browser-rendered wrapper; only iOS may use the temporary browser/PWA fallback. Nodes run without requiring a Home and may join the household grid within measured native capabilities. Paired nodes receive truthful version, size, digest, and same-origin content-addressed package metadata only when the package exists.
Unsupported lighting or acoustic hardware is clearly unavailable, never simulated as applied.
Every setting declares its scope and no consumer page requires engineering vocabulary.

Credentials remain in protected adapter storage, never UI snapshots, logs or model context. Validated optional source/provider playback is normal functionality, not blanket beta. Personal/public-domain remains default. Schema 1/2 native snapshots migrate with optional sources unavailable pending revalidation and no inherited handoff consent. Source revocation preserves personal originals and metadata. Unverified official app handoffs remain individually experimental and use only verified destinations; no protected-stream capture or universal Cast claims. Policy/migration tests do not certify a working provider or handoff adapter.

Only an explicitly pinned Day-0 Ed25519 key may authorize an exact platform artifact. Android update metadata is paired-device-only and binds a same-origin immutable URL to the bytes and SHA-256 actually served; no APK is advertised when absent. Activation requires a version-matched health response; failure restores and verifies the previous release or reports recovery-required. Recovery export/import is checksummed, allowlisted, credential-free, confirmed, and preserves overwritten state. Windows and Linux remain uncertified until real-device trials pass.

Playback has priority; machine use reflects measured hardware rather than invented claims. Android nodes announce the same household-grid identity and a truthful local capability stage; they must not accept transcoding until measured safety gates pass. Predictive idle preparation selects bounded title/device/network renditions within the storage-slider budget; deterministic scheduling works without ML, and private learning must demonstrate improved preparation hit-rate within budgets. Verify device compatibility, representative quality, disk-full/interruption recovery, atomic publication, access revocation, provider backoff, single-source reuse, and playback/thermal/user-pressure yield. Relay requires authenticated measured peers, not a default IP. Live video encoding requires two ten-minute measured runs at >=1.20x for the relevant conversion with bounded resources and no pressure abort; RAM alone never qualifies it. Offline jobs may be slower than real time but require measured estimates, bounded retries, and cancellation. Cached hardware policy must be invalidated when local CPU/RAM identity differs; policy microbenchmarks are not encoding certification. Measure content-aware encoding recipes on representative dark/grain/action/animation samples; retain codec/quality validation. Predict buffer starvation or resource anomalies early, but select only tested non-destructive recovery actions; enforce playback priority and pressure yield regardless of model output.

Production semantic/taste embeddings must be genuine learned 512D Float32 vectors with model/version provenance and measured quality; hashed features, padded fixtures and regex do not satisfy learned semantic retrieval. Validate algorithm-appropriate updates, including Sherman-Morrison only for relevant inverse matrices, and profile-private persistence. Models never make access, child-safety, credential, or destructive decisions. Learning and cached-title analysis happen strictly on-device. Reuse versioned local analysis by exact media edition, audio track, timebase and model version; test deduplication, resumable jobs, provider backoff, source revocation, budget/yield, uncertainty and stale-result invalidation. No learning exports outside the Home, including anonymous taste exchanges. Authorized within-Home matching stays separate from external services. Media, transcripts, scene/audio analysis, family settings, histories, credentials, gradients and model weights stay local. Verify OS-enforced model-worker network isolation before activation; registry metadata alone is not evidence. No AI prompts or opt-in ceremony; privacy documentation describes the actual behavior.
Promotion requires a separately approved rights, service, and safety plan.
Promotion requires authenticated enrollment, consent, packet signing, and threat review.
